name: What are the differences between wood-burning and gas outdoor fireplaces?

mainEntity.name: What are the differences between wood-burning and gas outdoor fireplaces?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wood-burning outdoor fireplaces offer the traditional crackle, aroma, and large flame of a natural fire, but require stocking wood, cleaning ash, and can produce smoke. Gas fireplaces, conversely, offer instant on/off convenience, clean burning with no ash or smoke, and precise heat control. However, they may require a gas line installation, and the flame appearance can differ. Your choice depends on aesthetic preference, convenience needs, and available fuel sources.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wood-burning offers traditional ambiance but requires more maintenance. Gas provides convenience, cleanliness, and instant heat with less effort.
